sources.HR1: Charles Edwards (Capriole), 'Hash Ribbons & Bitcoin Bottoms', Medium 2019-10-30: 1-month SMA of BTC hash rate crossing above 2-month SMA marks the end of miner capitulation (buy).
sources.SE1: Long, Zaremba, Demir, Szczygielski, Vasenin, 'Seasonality in the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns', Finance Research Letters 35 (2020) 101566: coins with high past same-weekday returns outperform on that weekday.
sources.EX1: Quantpedia (C. Dujava), 'Cryptocurrency Market Dynamics Around Bitcoin Futures Expiration Events', 2024-03-27: around the CME expiry (last Friday of the month) hold the Thursday before, the weekend and Monday after, avoid the expiry day itself.

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user. No variants after the result; the round ends whatever the outcome.
universe: exactly ADR 0047/0096-0109 U50 (cut-off bar i-2), recomputed at every rebalance

segments.rebalance: DAILY (hold = 1) from the first Monday of the eval range; trade at open of day i; real funding; ADR 0041 calibrated cost on every weight change. For the two timing trials, when the rule stays on and the U50 set is unchanged the drifted holdings are kept (no re-weighting trade).
segments.BTCUSDT: not read in S2 (Coin Metrics BTC HashRate is a network series, not a BTC price)
segments.hashrate_rows: only rows dated inside the segment read range; value for day d is the Coin Metrics row dated d; only days <= cut

trials.HR1_HASHRIBBON_U50: H = Coin Metrics btc HashRate. SMA30 and SMA60 of H over days cut-29..cut and cut-59..cut (>= 25 and >= 50 valid values). If SMA30 > SMA60 hold the equal-weight U50 long (1/n each), else flat.
trials.SE1_SAMEWEEKDAY_U50: For trading day i with weekday w: signal = mean of open-to-open daily returns r_d (open d+1 / open d - 1) over days d <= cut, d >= i-364, weekday(d) = w (>= 12 values). Long the HIGHEST quintile, short the LOWEST (wide_universe_dev.pick, long_top=True). Rebalanced every day.
trials.EX1_EXPIRY_WINDOW_U50: F = last Friday of the calendar month (UTC, no holiday adjustment). Hold the equal-weight U50 long on days Thursday F-1, Saturday F+1, Sunday F+2, Monday F+3 (each day = open of that day to open of the next); flat on every other day including F.

decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0109 (newsrc_engine.flag): S1 SR > expected max of 3 null trials, alpha t >= 2, both S1 halves > 0, S2 > 0.5, S1 cal_x2 > 0 and cal_tail_x2 > 0; DSR N=3 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 reported.
after_result: Trial count +3 regardless. If nothing passes: report NOT_PROMISING and stop (no further rounds in this thread).
